title: Workshop of Wonders
description: Combine materials, discover recipes, and unlock new workshop areas.
longDescription: A browser crafting and discovery game. Start with simple materials, follow quests, and grow your workshop through new discoveries. The repository is named doodle-craft.
instructions: Tap an item in your bag, then tap a square on the crafting table. When a recipe produces an item, press Collect. Follow the quests to discover new materials and areas. Use Help for guidance.

title: Pirate Adventure
description: Chart a course and uncover island treasure.
longDescription: Chart a course and uncover island treasure. This bundled sample is a small click-to-score demo, not your original game.
instructions: Press the action button to score. Reach ten points to win; restart to try again.

title: Suit Derby
description: Four horses, one deck of cards. Race with friends using play credits.
longDescription: A multiplayer card-driven horse race. Each suit has a horse, and each drawn card moves its horse one space. The first horse across the finish wins. Play credits only; no real money.
instructions: Enter a display name and create a room, then share its room code or invite link with friends. Other players enter their names and join the room. Keep the host’s browser open during play. Everyone starts with 100 play credits; no real money is used.
